_comment: Per-model overrides applied by import_results.py on every import. Keys are Ollama model names.

no_native_tools.gemma3:4b: The Ollama chat template for this model has no native tool-calling support, so the harness cannot issue tool calls. Its 0 on JSON/schema/tool/multi-step and 100 on injection reflect that, not model quality. Not comparable to other models.
no_native_tools.phi4:14b: The Ollama chat template for this model has no native tool-calling support, so the harness cannot issue tool calls. Its 0 on JSON/schema/tool/multi-step and 100 on injection reflect that, not model quality. Not comparable to other models.

vram_32k_gb._comment: Measured GPU memory at the bench's 32K context (KV cache included): the SIZE column of `ollama ps` (Ollama 0.40.6, 100% GPU, CONTEXT 32768) logged on the RTX 3090 right after each model's main-suite run (ops/pod_gpu_run*.log). null = not measured: the model had already unloaded (empty ps line) or ps reported an implausible size (gemma4 models: 588 MB / 1.5 GB / 1.4 GB, smaller than their weights).

tier_override._comment: Results v0.1.2 (2026-10-26): GPU tiers are assigned by measured VRAM at 32K context on the RTX 3090 (vram_32k_gb above must be <= the tier's card VRAM). These runs were tagged hardware.tier_gb=from_tier_gb in their raw result files; import_results.py publishes them in tier_gb and keeps the previous tier/rank as prev_tier_gb/prev_rank. Raw result files are unchanged.
